content: Go child-process cleanup: set SysProcAttr{Setpgid:true} so child gets own process group; kill whole group with syscall.Kill(-pid, SIGKILL). exec.CommandContext/Cancel only kills the direct child, not grandchildren; Go 1.20+ Cancel+WaitDelay helps but process-group kill is the robust pattern. Without Setpgid, grandchildren are orphaned to init when parent dies.
